about: The plugins the tehas maintainers build and vet. A plugin is listed as vetted only at a pinned commit that ran on a host.

plugins.name: panels
plugins.about: Outside pages of the project, such as a support chat, in the dashboard's dock

plugins.name: hoststats
plugins.about: The host's CPU, memory, disk and processes, as tehas top shows them

plugins.name: energy
plugins.about: The power the factory's models draw, now and over 24 hours and 30 days

plugins.name: business
plugins.about: The factory overview: the production line, the issue board, the running cycles and the last ten days

plugins.name: floorplan
plugins.about: A map of the product repository in the dashboard, and after each cycle a commit status on what the pull request did to its health check

plugins.name: review
plugins.about: A scheduled review of the product's recent changes, with drafted issues for what it finds

plugins.name: guard
plugins.about: Scheduled security checks of the product's recent changes: credentials, risky dependency and CI changes, and a model's security reading; findings stay on the host

plugins.name: wiki
plugins.about: A product wiki built from the repository and its history

plugins.name: given
plugins.about: Before a cycle starts, gives it the text files and zips its approved issue links, and describes the issue's images in words

plugins.name: goldfish
plugins.about: Checks each pull request a cycle offers against the approved issue body and its pi-spec criteria, with fresh model readers

plugins.name: pageticket
plugins.about: Point at a page of the product, say what is wrong, and file it as a drafted issue

plugins.name: lab
plugins.about: Prototypes from marked issues, served as pages of their own

plugins.name: specs
plugins.about: Skills for the chats: grill an idea, write a spec, slice it, brief it

plugins.name: tutor
plugins.about: A course in Obeya's chat that teaches how the factory decides

plugins.name: voice
plugins.about: Talk to a chat by voice, through a speech host on the tailnet; the model's words land in the chat's input

plugins.name: console
plugins.about: A person's own tehas dev session (pi-rukas) in the browser, for logins the factory lists. Never a shell on the host

plugins.name: rsi
plugins.about: Self-improvement: reads the factory's ended cycles and industry's logs, anonymised, and drafts issues on what made cycles fail or stall
